collection.title: Mercedes-Benz AMG GT Hatchback 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz AMG GT 2022 onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" on the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
